name: 李俊賢
objective: Matlab and Simulink, dynamic systems modeling, time-domain analysis, root locus analysis, frequency-domain analysis, PID controller design, lag-lead compensator design, case studies, and special topics.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Introduction
Week 2: Matlab Tutorial
Week 3: Simulink Tutorial
Week 4: Modeling and Simulation
Week 5: Time-Domain Analysis
Week 6: Root Locus Analysis
Week 7: Frequency-Domain Analysis
Week 8: PID Controller Design
Week 9: Delta HMI
Week 10: Delta PLC (1/2)
Week 11: Delta PLC (2/2)
Week 12: Delta VFD
Week 13: Delta ASDA (1/2)
Week 14: Delta ASDA (2/2)
Week 15: Delta Integrated Applications
Week 16: Final (hands-on)
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Week 17: 控制系統文獻研討; Week 18: 控制系統研討簡報。
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          研讀近年控制系統文獻，並以簡報方式呈現。
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          10%
